files.description: Consult when a change touches any file: defines what ies-client is and is not, its layout, release model and local invariants.
Consult when a change touches secret access, IAM or how consumers install and import the package: defines the rotation safety pattern, the IAM roles on the refresh-token secrets and the install line.
Consult when a change touches the gcloud variant: the REST variant defines the same public API and rotation steps, which stay in parity.
